subject: Tundra status: detection + SFT hardened, ASR risk materializing
body:
Hi Daniela, Lucia,

Status. The May 15 milestone landed on time: the OWL-v2 detection path (HungarianMatcher + focal loss) passes the full regression suite, and the location-tokenization VLM path matches our old stack's mAP within 0.3 on the internal detection benchmark while cutting per-engagement setup from about two weeks to two days thanks to the config-driven strategy layer. Carmen's Swahili SFT demo trains end to end with the chat template and prompt masking working exactly as designed - the loss curves are clean.

The risk Daniela called is materializing: the USM encoder integration for ASR has awkward interactions with Seq2SeqTrainer's batching when audio lengths vary widely - padding blows up memory on long-tail clips. Linnea has a bucketing-sampler fix half-working, but honest estimate is June 26 for a hardened ASR path, not June 12.

No ask yet, just early warning so the customer-engagement date doesn't get promised against ASR.

Ondrej
